NO for anything since: no test has been run that could have refuted it in five years of walk. The causal story ('wall = fuel') is asserted on top of the correlation, never tested against the alternative (the resting side is where the informed capital sits and price is drawn to it).

audits.the_argument: Two arms. (i) SIZE: up-size the Thursday magnitude prior. (ii) SIDE: the post-print LEG sides with the running chain, never the print sign; the DAY NET is owned by the chain state. The SIZE arm is measurable and I measured it. The SIDE arm is the problem: its entire evidence field is a per-event narrative of the form 'date, actual net, the chain was X, so the chain won' - the chain state is read at the same time as the outcome and the rule is confirmed by the outcome. It is a 10,599-character evidence block containing no count that could have gone the other way, and every counterexample produced a NEW conditioning dimension rather than a refutation: 1120 -> the leg-vs-net split (S97.2); the G9 bullish-draw sells -> polarity (S98.2); 0129/0205/0212 -> spent-chain scoping (S101.3); the G14 blind -> chain-state-is-tape-state (S102.1); 0326 -> S1-void damping (a whole new play). Five successive rescues, each on n<=3. The forward_evidence field claiming '14 storage Thursdays, every one leg-sided with the running chain' is a 14/14 record for a rule that the same file documents breaking at 1120, 0129 and 0326 - the 14/14 survives only because each break was reclassified into a different arm first.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: SIZE arm: yes, and I ran it. SIDE arm: no. 'The chain won' is unfalsifiable once the chain can be relabelled live/spent/young/basing after the fact, and the play's own history is a record of exactly that relabelling. The leg-side arm is ALSO not independently re-measurable in the committed corpus - g<N>_mbo_evidence.json serves only 3 coarse phases per day (sflow/pxchg/vol), not a print-anchored decomposition, so nobody can recompute 'leg-sided with the chain' from the record.
